name: Floor Keeper
notes: The floor boss. Takes turns between a ground slam and a wide sweep all around itself, and calls in two swarmers at half health. Only place it in open rooms.
description: The guardian of the floor's last room. It slams, it sweeps, and it calls for help when hurt.

bestiary.tip: Watch the ground: a slam hits in front, a sweep hits all around.

lore.white: The Floor Keeper once kept the lamps lit on each floor. Now it guards the dark instead.
lore.yellow: This Keeper is older and stronger. A faint glow still flickers deep inside it.
lore.orange: The highest Keeper stands near a spark of the old light. Maybe it wants to be free.
